product_definition: The product evaluates whether a chosen page can compete for a concrete search query: query relevance is checked first, then page quality and competitor context are used when enough SERP pages are processed.
verification_commands: cd backend && .venv\Scripts\python.exe -m pytest tests\test_live_relevance_regression.py tests\test_query_relevance_runtime.py tests\test_final_query_competitiveness.py -q -p no:cacheprovider
cd backend && .venv\Scripts\python.exe -m pytest tests\test_competitiveness_score.py tests\test_competitors.py tests\test_competitor_fetch_robustness.py -q -p no:cacheprovider
npm --prefix frontend run test -- --run src/lib/ui.test.tsx src/lib/auditReport.test.ts
